Job Title- Full Stack Engineer

Position type- Full Time

Work Location- Bangalore/Noida/Gurgaon

Working style- Hybrid

Cab Facility- Yes

Shift Time -12 PM to 9 PM

People Manager role: No

Required education and certifications critical for the role-

BTech in Computer Science or related quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Required years of experience

6-10 years of relevant experience

AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

General description of role:

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with strong hands-on experience in ReactJS and Python (FastAPI) to design and build scalable, modular, microservice based high performing web applications. The ideal candidate should also have some exposure to C# or Java, a good understanding of cloud native architecture (Azure, AWS) and a product or platform mindset- capable of developing reusable templates, dynamic API generation and modern frontend frameworks. Exposure to AI driven development and interest in leveraging GenAI frameworks will be a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities:

Frontend

Strong proficiency in ReactJS, JavaScript (ES6+) and Typescript
Experience in component-based architecture, state management (Redux/ContextAPI) and responsive design
Familiarities with UI frameworks (Ex. Bootstrap) and tools (Ex. Figma)

Backend

Strong experience in Python (FastAPI) for building scalable API
Good understanding of asynchronous programming, ORM frameworks etc.
Exposure to C# (.NET core) or Java (Spring Boot) microservices

Cloud and DevOps

Hands on with Azure or AWS (App service, Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, or equivalent)
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) and containerization (Docker/ Kubernetes)

Database and Integration

Experience with relational and NoSQL databases
Knowledge of message queues

Architectures and Patterns

Understanding of microservices, event driven and serverless patterns
Experience in template-based UI/API generation, schema first API designs etc.

AI and emerging Tech (Preferred)

Exposure to LLMs, AI APIs (Azure OpenAPI, AWS Bedrock), AI assisted code generation tools.

Skills and experience that will lead to success.

Technical Excellence – Full stack proficiency, API first thinking, Cloud native engineering
Architectural Thinking – Platform mindset, system design.
Innovation and AI awareness – automation, reusability
Collaboration and delivery – Agile mindset and excellent communication with a continuous learning mindset

How this opportunity is different –

Work with cutting edge cutting edge, AI augmented platforms
Opportunity to contribute to reusable frameworks and accelerators
Collaborative, innovative- driven engineering culture
Cross functional learning- GenAI, data engineering, and API development

HOW WE SUPPORT OUR COLLEAGUES

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workforce. At Aon, we believe a diverse workforce is an innovative workforce. Our agile, inclusive environment allows colleagues to manage their wellbeing and work/life balance while empowering you to be your authentic self.

Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging them to take time to focus on themselves. We offer a variety of workstyle options through our Smart Working model, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips colleagues to learn, share and grow, helping them achieve their fullest potential. As a result, Aon colleagues are more connected, more relevant and more valued.

COMMITMENT TO SUSTAINABILITY

“Aon is dedicated to integrating sustainability into our core business practices. We strive to minimize our environmental impact through innovative solutions and responsible stewardship, ensuring a sustainable future for our clients and communities
